lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It runs in four seconds, the way it always does, and it does not close.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Off by a constant. Not a rounding drift, not a rate change. The same figure, every quarter, as far back as the shell will index.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: There is one line it cannot allocate to a department: 88-231-C. Quarterly. Outbound.
